Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 35 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Anita - 65 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sonali - 26 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Neeta - 30 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The airport - check-in counters, big windows
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Anita and Neeta stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Vinod (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

[Vinod throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Anita (laughing): "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Vinod: "What a nice place."

[Vinod's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Vinod (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Vinod's car crashes into a pole.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

[Vinod loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vinod (softly): "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The airport - Day

[Vinod stands at the airport. Anita and Sonali stand near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod drags his suitcase to the gate.]

Vinod: "This is amazing!"

[Vinod hugs Mother goodbye at the airport.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

[Vinod waves goodbye as he goes through security.]

Vinod (happily): "Sonali, are you okay?"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Vinod is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Anita and Sonali stand near him.]

Sonali: "Vinod, look over here."

[Vinod, very old now, passes away quietly.]

Anita: "We have to be strong now."
